description: This file defines theme-related functions for a frontend project, including a base theme object with colors and typography, and functions to generate color palettes and category-to-color mappings based on the theme.

methods.name: getOceanTheme
methods.description: Returns the Ocean Professional base theme tokens including colors, typography, radius, and elevation settings.

methods.name: getCategoricalPalette
methods.description: Generates a deterministic color palette seeded by the Ocean theme colors, suitable for categorical data visualization.

methods.name: getCategoryColorMap
methods.description: Maps category names to colors from the categorical palette, maintaining stable order.
